verses.t: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
verses.pickthall: By those that winnow with a winnowing

verses.t: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
verses.pickthall: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

verses.t: And those [ships] sailing with ease
verses.pickthall: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

verses.t: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter
verses.pickthall: And those who distribute (blessings) by command

verses.t: Indeed, what you are promised is true
verses.pickthall: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true

verses.t: And indeed, the recompense is to occur
verses.pickthall: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall

verses.t: By the heaven containing pathways
verses.pickthall: By the heaven full of paths

verses.t: Indeed, you are in differing speech
verses.pickthall: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth)

verses.t: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded
verses.pickthall: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse

verses.t: Destroyed are the falsifiers
verses.pickthall: Accursed be the conjecturers

verses.t: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless
verses.pickthall: Who are careless in an abyss

verses.t: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense
verses.pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment

verses.t: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
verses.pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire

verses.t: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient
verses.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten

verses.t: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs
verses.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings

verses.t: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good
verses.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good

verses.t: They used to sleep but little of the night
verses.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night

verses.t: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness
verses.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness

verses.t: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived
verses.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share

verses.t: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
verses.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure

verses.t: And in yourselves. Then will you not see
verses.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see

verses.t: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised
verses.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised

verses.t: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking
verses.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak

verses.t: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham
verses.pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)

verses.t: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown
verses.pickthall: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me)

verses.t: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
verses.pickthall: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf

verses.t: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat
verses.pickthall: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat

verses.t: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy
verses.pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son

verses.t: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman
verses.pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman

verses.t: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing
verses.pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower

verses.t: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers
verses.pickthall: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)

verses.t: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
verses.pickthall: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk

verses.t: To send down upon them stones of clay
verses.pickthall: That we may send upon them stones of clay

verses.t: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors
verses.pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton

verses.t: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers
verses.pickthall: Then we brought forth such believers as were there

verses.t: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims
verses.pickthall: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah)

verses.t: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment
verses.pickthall: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom

verses.t: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority
verses.pickthall: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant

verses.t: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman
verses.pickthall: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman

verses.t: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy
verses.pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate

verses.t: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind
verses.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them

verses.t: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins
verses.pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust

verses.t: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time
verses.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile

verses.t: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on
verses.pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed

verses.t: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves
verses.pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves

verses.t: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient
verses.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk

verses.t: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander
verses.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof)

verses.t: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer
verses.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)

verses.t: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember
verses.pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect

verses.t: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner
verses.pickthall: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him

verses.t: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner
verses.pickthall: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him

verses.t: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman
verses.pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman

verses.t: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people
verses.pickthall: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk

verses.t: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed
verses.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy

verses.t: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers
verses.pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers

verses.t: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me
verses.pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me

verses.t: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me
verses.pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me

verses.t: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength
verses.pickthall: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might

verses.t: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me
verses.pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day)

verses.t: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised
verses.pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised
